metadata.modeling_rule: MORE is treated as a distinct grassroots movement of PCA Ruling Elders; hosting on Jude 3 does not collapse the two organizations into one.

positions.summary: MORE in the PCA describes its mission as encouraging PCA Ruling Elders who have not been active in Presbytery and General Assembly to begin attending and participating.
MORE grounds increased Ruling Elder participation in BCO 8-3, emphasizing Ruling Elders' duties in government, discipline, and oversight of the Church generally when called thereunto.

MORE argues that the roughly 4:1 Teaching Elder to Ruling Elder ratio at the 2017 General Assembly undermined the PCA's intended plurality of elders and represented a confessional-operational problem.
positions.boundary: This is preserved as MORE's diagnosis, not as an independently adjudicated conclusion of this project.

positions.summary: MORE states that a primary practical goal is to provide financial support for Ruling Elders who otherwise could not attend General Assembly, in order to increase Ruling Elder participation in church courts.
